name: Delicious Mint Bubblegum
desc: A soft, chewy candy. Its fresh flavor glides smoothly down your throat, bringing an instantly cool and refreshing sensation. Better still, with a gentle puff, you can blow a clear, glossy bubble. A perfect little treat for passing the time!

customize.name: Mint Bubblegum
